name: Exercise — Communications Check (1 Hour)
description: A short communications verification exercise. Tests that all communication channels (radio, phone, email, chat) work correctly and that contact lists are up to date. Run monthly or before major operations.

groups.name: All Stations
groups.description: All participating stations, teams, or individuals

events.title: Announce Comms Check
events.description: Comms lead announces the exercise on the primary channel. All stations acknowledge.

events.title: Primary Channel Roll Call
events.description: Test primary communication channel. Each station responds in sequence.

events.title: Secondary Channel Test
events.description: Switch to backup/secondary channel. Repeat roll call.

events.title: Alert Notification Test
events.description: Send test alert via SMS/email/app. All stations confirm receipt and response time.

events.title: Results Compiled
events.description: Comms lead compiles results: who responded, response times, any failures.

events.title: Comms Check Complete
events.description: Exercise concluded. Issues logged for follow-up. Contact lists updated if needed.
